turns.q: My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
turns.replyTail:
says:
I’m sorry your item arrived damaged. Please submit Wild Earth’s warranty form with your contact details, order number (if available), product name, issue description, and photos. Wild Earth will review it and forward it to the manufacturer for a final decision. Defective or incorrect items are replaced with return shipping arranged. Receipt is usually confirmed within 1–2 business days; returned items must be clean and dry.
